title: fix(app-shell): Setup record pages carry the managed-by note on the header chip (#13385)
body:
Closes #13385
Clause-②: yes (widening: RecordContextValue gains optional objectLabelNote; RecordTitleChip props gain optional objectLabelNote; nothing is refused)
Closes #12614

This carries out the maintainer's ruling **B** on #13385 (comment 6369308948), which amends #12194 option a for Setup record pages only. #12614's remaining item is item 2, and this is that change. Item 1 was done in objectstack-ai/objectstack#23838.

## What changed

- **Setup record pages draw no floating `ManagedByBadge`.** `RecordDetailView` leaves the badge out of `sharedChrome` (the floating row and the print chrome row) when the page is inside Setup.
- **The header's object label carries the note instead.** `RecordDetailView` hands the badge's note to `RecordContextProvider` as the new host-injected `objectLabelNote`. `PageHeaderRenderer` (`page:header`) forwards it to `RecordTitleChip`.
- **The chip shows it on hover and focus.** With a note, `RecordTitleChip` makes its object-label span a focusable (`tabIndex=0`) tooltip trigger, using the same `Tooltip` setup it already uses for copy-id. The tooltip reads e.g. "Organization · Managed by the identity provider" (zh: 「组织 · 由身份提供方管理」). The note is also the span's `aria-describedby`, pointing at an `sr-only` sibling, so the description is there whether or not the tooltip is open. Without a note, the label draws exactly as before (pinned on its exact HTML).
- **`ManagedByBadge.tsx`** gains `useManagedByNote(managedBy)`, which shares the variant lookup with the badge. Its docblock records the Setup carve-out.
- **No other changes.** List headers (`ObjectView`) and every record page outside Setup keep the badge unchanged. No shadcn file is touched, and no locale key is added.

Both new members have doc comments saying they are host-injected and what they show. `RecordContextValue` has no zod mirror. It does have a type-level value-shape pin (`RecordContext.valueShape.pin.test.tsx`: the `MEMO_DEP_KEYS` must equal `keyof RecordContextValue`), and that pin went red under type-check until the new key was listed. The key is now in the provider's memo dependency list and in that pin. `RecordTitleChip` props have no mirror or snapshot. Docs: `packages/components/README.md` gains a short section on the label's host note.

## Judgment calls

1. **How Setup is detected: from the route.** `isSetupAppSegment(appName)` matches both the package id `com.objectstack.setup` and the name `setup`. It is the helper `ObjectView` already uses for its Setup-only list shape. A `sys_*` object opened in another app keeps the floating badge, as does a page with no `:appName`.
2. **Note text: the badge's existing tooltip title** (`managedByBadge.KEY.title`, e.g. `betterAuth.title`: 「由身份提供方管理」 / "Managed by the identity provider"). The `body` strings are paragraph-length. `platform` (and no value, or an unknown value) gives no note, as the badge draws nothing for them. No new locale keys, so no parity change.
3. **Gate kept.** The note sits behind the same `useCanAuthorMetadata()` gate as the badge, so a caller who could not see the badge sees no note either.
4. **Changeset levels:** `@object-ui/react` minor and `@object-ui/components` minor, because each adds an optional member to a published type. This follows the precedent of #13216, which scored `RecordTitleChip`'s optional `titleNode` minor. `@object-ui/app-shell` is patch. There is one changeset file and no `major`, and `check-changeset-no-major` is green.
5. **Surface:** the seat approved widening the declared surface by three files (`RecordContext.tsx`, `containers.tsx` (`PageHeaderRenderer`) and `RecordTitleChip.tsx`), because the chip is drawn by `page:header` in `@object-ui/components`, and `RecordDetailView` can only reach it through the host-injected `RecordContext`. The README section and the value-shape pin follow from those files.

## Tests

New:
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/record-title-chip.objectLabelNote-13385.test.tsx` (6): CONTROL, the label is byte-identical without a note (no focus stop, no `aria-describedby`); with a note, the label is a focusable trigger described by the note; focusing it opens a tooltip reading "Organization · NOTE"; a note with no label draws nothing; `PageHeaderRenderer` forwards the note from the context; CONTROL, a context with no note gives the plain label.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.setupManagedByChip-13385.test.tsx` (5), mounted on the real `/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId` route: a Setup `sys_organization` page (`com.objectstack.setup`, and `setup`) draws no floating badge and its header chip carries "Managed by the identity provider"; CONTROL, a business-app (`crm`) record page still draws the floating badge for an author, with no chip note; CONTROL, an end user in Setup sees neither; CONTROL, a `platform` object in Setup gives no note.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.setupListBadge-13385.test.tsx` (2): CONTROL, the list header still draws the badge for an author in Setup and in a business app. `ObjectView.tsx` itself is not in the diff.

Updated: `RecordContext.valueShape.pin.test.tsx` lists `objectLabelNote`.

Results:
- **Every `RecordDetailView.*` test, every `*managedByBadge*` test (ObjectView, RecordDetailView, RecordFormPage), `page-header*` and `record-title-chip*`:** 98 files, 722 tests passed (`--maxWorkers=2`). This run was on the first commit, which is the same code as HEAD; the second commit changes only test files.
- **`packages/react/src/context/`:** 13 files, 139 tests passed.
- **Type-check** (`turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/react --filter=@object-ui/components --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`): 32/32 tasks successful.
- **ESLint on touched files:** 0 errors (warnings only, all already in the base files).
- **Gates:** `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new; `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major` are green.

**Ablation** (each restored from HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards):
- With the Setup condition forced off in `RecordDetailView`, the 2 Setup cases went red and the other 5 in those two files stayed green.
- With `RecordTitleChip` drawing the plain label whatever the note, 3 of 6 went red (the trigger, the tooltip and the header forward cases); the two CONTROLs and the no-label case stayed green.
- With the forward removed from `PageHeaderRenderer`, only the forward case went red (1 of 6).

**Screenshots:** not taken. Booting a Setup rig (objectstack dev server, console and a seeded admin) did not fit the time box. The 1280 px light and dark screenshots from the done-when are still owed.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
